ini.text:
; DLSSG SM86 - frame generation for Ampere (RTX 30) and newer.
; Copy version.dll, this INI and the dlssg_sm86\ folder beside the rendering EXE. Use ONE proxy DLL at a time:
; version.dll first. Only if the game never loads it, delete it and try the proxies in alternatives\ one by one, in this
; order: winmm.dll, dbghelp.dll, dinput8.dll, then dxgi.dll or d3d12.dll (render-path proxies: last resort, never both).
; See alternatives\README.md.
; The DLSS-G runtime, the SM86 backend, the kernel packs and the super-resolution snippet are FILES under dlssg_sm86\,
; found relative to the proxy's own folder - nothing is embedded and nothing is ever written to %LOCALAPPDATA%. Restart
; the game after changing this file.
; This is the full release configuration: four consistency tiers. Every diagnostic / compatibility / performance knob
; still works but is left out here and takes its safe, validated default; the complete list is in docs\INSTALL.md / INSTALL.en.md
; (advanced / diagnostic keys).
; RTX 20 (Turing) ???????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????? SM75?????????????????????????????????????????????
; ??????????????????Router / SM75Family / KernelImage / SpoofArchToGame / ?????????????????????????????? docs\INSTALL.md???
; ????????????????????????????????? [FrameGeneration] / [Runtime] / [Logging]???DLSS ???????????? [DLSSG]???XeSS ???????????? [XeSSFG]?????????????????????????????????
; Two engines: common keys in [FrameGeneration] / [Runtime] / [Logging], DLSS-only keys in [DLSSG], XeSS-only in [XeSSFG].

[General]
; 1 = frame generation on (our bundled, Ampere-optimized DLSS-G runtime). 0 = off: the game's own DLSS-G loads
; unchanged, which means no frame generation on Ampere. The proxy still forwards the real system DLL either way.
Enabled=1

[FrameGeneration]
; Engine: DLSS = NVIDIA's DLSS-G model on this project's SM86/SM75 kernels (default). XeSS = Intel's XeSS-FG model on
; this project's own runner (dlssg_sm86\xefg\xefg_kernels.dll; Intel's libxess_fg.dll is not used), 2X only. A back
; buffer it cannot run (RGBA16F) falls back to DLSS by itself.
; ???????????????DLSS = NVIDIA DLSS-G ????????????????????? SM86/SM75 ?????????????????????XeSS = Intel XeSS-FG ???????????????????????????????????????
; ??? 2X????????? Intel ??? libxess_fg.dll????????????????????????????????????RGBA16F??????????????? DLSS??????
Engine=DLSS
; Frame-generation multiplier ceiling: 3 = up to 4X (factory default), 5 = up to 6X. Engine=XeSS clamps it to 1 (2X).
; The game requests its own count within this; a game with dynamic MFG otherwise runs at the maximum by default, which
; users found too high (issues #497/#499). A game whose own Streamline plugin is 4X stays at 4X either way.
; Clamped to what the bundled runtime (310.9.16) supports: 6X.
; ???????????????3 = ?????? 4X???5 = ?????? 6X???Engine=XeSS ????????? 1???2X??????
MaxGeneratedFrames=1

[DLSSG]
; Read only by Engine=DLSS. / ?????? Engine=DLSS ?????????
; Consistency tier (until 2026-10-14 [FrameGeneration] Optimized, still read): how far the generated image may move
; from what the official NVIDIA runtime would produce.
; ????????????????????? [FrameGeneration] Optimized???????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????
; 0 = stock, the runtime's original numerics only / ????????????????????????????????????????????????
; 1 = every acceleration that keeps the output BIT-IDENTICAL to the official runtime (the reference to compare with)
;     / ????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????
; 2 = tier 1 plus lossy image kernels (default). Not bit-identical: 44-53 dB PSNR against the
;     official output on real 4K captures, lowest on the fastest motion; side by side against ground truth, no
;     difference from tier 1 was visible.
;     / ?????????????????? 1 ????????????????????????????????????????????????????????? 4K ???????????????????????? PSNR 44-53 dB
;     ???????????????????????????????????????????????????????????? 1 ??????????????????
; 3 = everything lossy that is still faster / ???????????????????????????????????????????????????
; Tiers 2 and 3 are not bit-exact. / ?????? 2???3 ?????????????????????
Optimized=1
; DLSS-G render preset (until 2026-10-14 [Compatibility] Preset, still read). Auto = let the game / driver profile
; decide (default). A = force UI recomposition off. B = force it on (cleaner HUD/UI inside generated frames), but B
; only takes effect when the game hands DLSS-G both a HUD-less image and a UI plane; most games do not, and then B is
; a no-op.
; C = FG Lite (opt-in): lighter candidate blending, about 32-54 % less GPU time per generated frame, slightly lower
; image quality (mostly on the HUD and at occlusion edges); uses this project's accelerated kernels like the default.
; C = ?????????????????????????????????????????? GPU ???????????? 32-54 %??????????????????????????? HUD ??????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????
Preset=Auto

[XeSSFG]
; Read only by Engine=XeSS. / ?????? Engine=XeSS ?????????
; Optical-flow resolution: Coarse / Middle / Fine; finer is slower. / ??????????????????Coarse / Middle / Fine??????????????????
FlowResolution=Middle
; 1 = when the game supplies a HUD-less image, feed it to the network and composite the UI (default); 0 = never.
; A game that supplies none runs as 0. / 1 = ??????????????? HUD ??????????????????????????????????????? UI???????????????0 = ????????????????????????????????? 0???
UseHudless=1

[Logging]
; 0 = off, 1 = errors, 2 = configuration and capability, 3 = kernel and evaluation traces. Written to Directory.
Level=3
FrameTiming=1
Directory=dlssg_sm86\logs

[Runtime]
; Bundled = the packaged runtime beside this INI, dlssg_sm86\runtime\nvngx_dlssg.dll, with its backend (normal use;
; no game DLL version matching). External / Pinned are advanced, see docs\INSTALL.md. Auto was removed in 0.4.0
; (it runs as Bundled). With [DLSSG] Preset=C, a Pinned / External runtime that cannot do C is replaced by the
; bundled one, so C always takes effect.
; ??????????????????Bundled = ????????? 310.9.16????????????????????????Auto ?????? 0.4.0 ???????????? Bundled???????????? Preset=C ??????Pinned / External ??????????????????????????? C ??????????????????????????? C ?????????
Mode=Bundled

[SuperResolution]
; DLSS Super Resolution, RTX 30 / RTX 20 only. Off = not touched (default). On = wherever the game uses preset L or M
; (usually Performance / Ultra Performance), that mode runs this project's INT8 kernels; no preset is changed.
; ???????????? RTX 30 / 20??????Off = ????????????????????????On = ????????????????????? L / M???????????????????????????????????? INT8 ????????????????????????
Mode=Off

[Debug]
Capture=12
CaptureSkip=110
CaptureStartOnReset=0
CaptureInputs=1
CaptureOutputs=1
CaptureNoStall=1
CaptureLean=1
CaptureMemoryMB=512
CaptureVramMB=256
